claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-431542 is a selective ALK4/ALK5/ALK7 (TGF-beta type I receptor) kinase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity, since its annotated targets are not required for survival of most cancer cell lines in short-term viability assays.
